title: …and the literal engine says the same thing about the same file, with the same code
note: The pair. One flag has one scope whichever engine ran, so the codes and the exit status of these two cases must match: a gate-refused relation the values read `violated` is `verification/refuted` and exit 1 on both. The differential gate asserts the property over the whole corpus; this pins it as a diff on the one model where the two engines disagreed.
